name: gf-space-sector-octroi
description: Apply the narrow French Guiana space-sector partial octroi relief from August 2026 under AP-2026-56 and AP-2026-57. Covers residual external OM, continuing OMR, cumulative activity and goods-annex conditions, own exclusive operational use, service operators, alternative uses, ordinary logistics exclusions and prohibition on combining exemptions. Use with the parent import and VAT Guide to test a proposed launch-equipment import before declaring. Includes the verified NAF and mast entry, corrected enacted-annex link, a recomputing tax example and an eligibility decision. Does not treat every space supplier as eligible or claim a complete classification crosswalk; precise goods, use and customs evidence remain essential.
